metadata.case_name: LEUNG YIU SHEUNG v. PA LING LOGISTICS CO LTD

injuries.description: fracture of the distal shaft of left tibia and fibula
contusion injury of both shoulders with soft tissue involvement
multiple surgical scars at left leg (6 scars at shin and anterior knee, including 3cm scar at anterior knee and 7cm scar at distal shin)

losses.description: fracture of left tibia and fibula, surgical fixation with IM nail, wound infection requiring debridement and implant removal, multiple surgical scars

mild left knee stiffness, mild left ankle stiffness, difficulty walking for long periods, difficulty squatting, can only walk on stairs slowly, reduced endurance on prolonged walking, standing, squatting
multiple surgical scars at left leg including 6 scars at shin and anterior knee (3cm scar at anterior knee, 7cm scar at distal shin)

reduced efficiency and capacity on prolonged driving and heavy object lifting/carrying, need to take regular breaks, need to seek help from co-workers for heavy items, limitation on heavy lifting and carrying, changed from full-time to casual employment
disabilities affected plaintiff's temper and social life in a negative way

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: affected by reduced mobility and physical limitations from leg injuries
need to seek help from co-workers in handling heavy delivery, reduced capacity for heavy manual work

comparable_cases.case_name: Chan Shing Ching v Hong Kong District Security Ltd and Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture at right tibia and fibular, wound debridement, external skeletal fixator, intramedullary nailing, skin graft wound infection, wheelchair for 4 months, walking frame/sticks, 11 months sick leave

comparable_cases.case_name: Ko Chu Keung v Temmuk Engineering Co Ltd And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fracture of right tibia and fibula, 10cm x 4cm contaminated open wound with exposed bone, intramedullary nailing, plating of fibula, second debridement, implant removal, 24 months sick leave

comparable_cases.case_name: Sukhdeep Singh v Chow Kin Hung And Another
comparable_cases.injury_description: fractured distal tibia and fibula of right leg, open reduction and internal fixation of fibula, nailing of tibia, bone graft from right knee, implant removal due to pain, 20 months sick leave

mild left knee stiffness and mild left ankle stiffness
multiple surgical scars at left leg
reduced efficiency and capacity for prolonged driving and heavy lifting
